name: evercore-memory
description: MCP server for self-hosted EverCore-compatible long-term coding memory.

env.name: EVERCORE_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL for the self-hosted EverCore service, for example http://localhost:1995.

env.name: EVERCORE_DEFAULT_USER_ID
env.description: Default user id for user/agent scoped memory.

env.name: EVERCORE_DEFAULT_SESSION_ID
env.description: Optional default session id for personal memory scopes.

env.name: EVERCORE_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer token when the EverCore endpoint is protected by auth.
